shared:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create an ORIGINAL cohesive 2D tower-defense game sprite atlas with NINE isolated objects on a precise THREE BY THREE regular square atlas. Transparent alpha background. Each square slot has identical size. Center each object within its own slot with at least12% transparent margin. Objects must not overlap other slots. No ground scene, no background, no gridlines, no labels, no caption. These are nine separate reusable sprites, not a poster.
The fixed semantic order is: ROW1: (1) ranged defender/tower, (2) cannon or magical offensive defender, (3) friendly support/slow defender. ROW2: (4) small mischievous enemy creature, (5) a leafy tree, (6) a decorative monument inspired by King Sejong seated with an open book and royal hat, peaceful and respectful, clearly stone/wood/ceramic sculpture not living combat unit. ROW3: (7) upright Hangul memorial stele with BLANK broad face for later crisp Korean engraving, (8) a stack of traditional stitch-bound books with one open book, blank pages, (9) traditional wooden printing-block desk with blank rectangular blocks.
Quality: deliberately refined MEDIUM-detail game art. Big legible shapes, maximum2-3 tones per material, only3-6 major parts in each object. No brick-by-brick textures, no metal rivets, no gold filigree, no photorealism, no dramatic spotlight, no ornate fantasy tower base, no tiny fabric folds, no magical halo, no particle cloud. These should feel authored, appealing and game-ready, not generic UI icons, but also NOT the highly rendered medieval mobile-game stock style. Small-scale visual readability is more important than realism. Bright daylight value range, confident saturated accent colors, no dark navy mood, no washed-out baby pastel. All assets use exactly the visual medium specified below, decisively DIFFERENT from traditional highly rendered fantasy sprites. The towers have low compact foundations. Monuments and environmental objects are fixed peaceful decorations, with no weapon parts. No legible text needed; leave book/stele faces blank. All artwork original.
Specific art direction and object design:

variants.name: 집현전 정원
variants.prompt: CLEAN 2D CEL ANIMATION: crisp warm-brown outlines, exactly TWO shadow levels, large painted color planes. Vermilion, jade, fresh leaf green, warm white. First defender is a blue-robed small scholar with a large brush-bow on low square stone foot; second an ochre wooden ink-cannon; third a jade book lantern shrine. Enemy a friendly-looking red ink goblin. Tree a rounded green gingko. Sejong statue is simple warm gray stone, books indigo/red. Elegant original Korean storybook GAME, not ornate buildings.

variants.name: 접힌 책의 나라
variants.prompt: LAYERED PAPER-CUT COLLAGE: flat colored cut-paper silhouettes with a single narrow paper-layer shadow, angular folded edges and visible simple paper construction, NO painted volumes. Sky blue, coral red, golden yellow, warm ivory, fresh green. Defenders are a folded-paper brush archer, a rolled-paper tube cannon, a folded blue book lighthouse. Enemy a red origami paper gremlin. Tree made of three green paper layers. Sejong monument is an ochre paper silhouette cutout on a paper plinth. Stele/books/printing desk all unmistakably constructed from cut paper. High graphic clarity, gentle irregular scissor-cut contours.

variants.name: 활자 공방 마을
variants.prompt: MATTE PAINTED WOODEN TOY GAME PIECES: simple carved chunky profiles, smooth flat wood surfaces, only a few broad grain marks, NO realistic texture. Must look like carefully designed physical small painted wooden toys in a bright tabletop game. Royal blue, saffron, leaf green, warm birch. Defenders: toy archer with brush as bolt, squat wooden drum cannon, stacked blue vowel-block support turret. Enemy: red wooden beetle. Broadleaf tree is a round carved shape with a flat base. Sejong statue a calm carved-wood toy king holding book, not metallic. Books and woodblock print bench extremely simple.

variants.name: 한글 골목 탐험
variants.prompt: STRICT CLEAN 32x32 PIXEL ART aesthetic enlarged with crisp nearest-neighbor square pixels. Bright daytime indie RPG palette: grass green, terracotta, cornflower blue, cream. Limited colors and purposeful pixel clusters, NO realistic rendering, no dither noise. Defender sprites: little blue scholar archer, red barrel cannon, teal book shrine; enemy orange imp with two eyes; tree lush compact gingko; stone Sejong statue simplified readable in32pixels; stele has blank cream face, stacked books and woodblock desk. Cheerful but not babyish. Every object truly visibly pixelated.

variants.name: 자모 누리마당
variants.prompt: KOREAN FOLK-PAINTING INSPIRED GRAPHIC GAME ART, flattened perspective, rhythmic bold brush contours, large opaque color planes, saturated vermilion, jade green, indigo, mustard and warm white. NOT intricate traditional painting: simplify every object to6major shapes. Defenders are stylized brush-crossbow pavilion, red drum cannon, blue book tower. Enemy playful striped little dokkaebi. Tree with decorative round leaf clusters. Sejong monument stone-white with simple ink lines, a blank-faced upright stele, book pile and woodblock desk. No shading gradients, no photorealism, no elaborate gold detail.

variants.name: 청자 물빛 정원
variants.prompt: STYLIZED MATTE CERAMIC MINIATURES with soft rounded outlines, ONE broad highlight and one broad shadow, no tiny reflected lights, no realistic glaze. Clear turquoise, cobalt, warm white porcelain, coral and fresh leaf green. Defenders a ceramic brush-bow ducklike turret, chunky blue teapot cannon, jade bell support shrine. Enemy a tiny coral ceramic ink creature. Tree rounded green ceramic canopy. Sejong statue warm-white porcelain seated king with open book and royal hat, simple expressive silhouette; blank white stele, blue/white ceramic book pile, clay woodblock-printing bench. Playful tactile objects, NOT detailed fantasy assets.

variants.name: 찰흙 글자숲
variants.prompt: HANDMADE STOP-MOTION CLAY GAME PIECES: rounded soft chunky forms with slight hand-pressed imperfections, simplified faces and broad matte shading. No shiny3D commercial render. Strong grass green, rust orange, cobalt, sunflower yellow and oatmeal white. Defenders are clay scholar archer with oversize brush, round ink-pot cannon, blue book support pedestal. Enemy a round orange ink blob with little legs. Friendly lumpy tree; Sejong statue ochre clay seated wise king with open book, simple features, hat obvious. Stele/books/printing desk chunky clay, no lettering, no fine texture.

variants.name: 글자 장터 수비대
variants.prompt: BOLD COMIC / SATURDAY-MORNING 2D CARTOON: thick dark brown outlines, confident exaggerated silhouettes, very flat two-tone shading, crisp energetic color. Vermilion, saffron, teal, warm ivory. Defenders a cheerful brush-bow scholar, squat cart-mounted drum cannon, a huge book with blue bookmark on a small stand. Enemy a red mischievous book-moth goblin. Tree simplified broad canopy. Sejong monument gray cartoon stone figure holding open book, calm dignified face, royal hat; blank stele, book stack and printing table rendered with same thick outlines. NO fine textures or metal intricacy.

variants.name: 훈민정음 산책길
variants.prompt: OPAQUE GOUACHE STORYBOOK GAME ART: gently irregular hand-painted outer edges, flat brushed pigment color blocks, minimal TWO-value shading. NO heavy black outline, NO detailed watercolor scene. Warm olive, vermilion, lapis blue, butter-yellow and warm ivory in bright daylight. Defenders a small brush archer in blue robe, terracotta ink mortar, lapis book lantern. Enemy a rust-orange foxlike ink sprite. Rounded gingko tree with three masses. Sejong statue pale sandstone painted simply, blank stele, stitched book stack and wooden printing table. Charming restrained medium detail, artistic rather than stock game render.

variants.name: 한글 연구소
variants.prompt: BRIGHT GRAPHIC SCI-FI GAME SPRITES: precise clean outlines, blocky modular shapes, white shells with cobalt panels and mustard accents, only one cel shadow. NOT medieval fantasy, NOT glowy cyberpunk. Defenders: white compact robotic brush-launcher, cobalt ink-jet cannon, turquoise rectangular glyph-screen support pylon. Enemy orange angular walking glitch bug. Tree in a simple white modular planter. Sejong monument white simplified sculpture of seated king with book on blue modern museum base; stele a blank white information monument; books and woodblock print desk displayed as clean museum objects. Friendly futuristic daytime design, no micro-rivets, no glowing halos.
